name: editor_context
description: Get the active editor file, language, cursor, selection, and selected text through VS Code.

name: editor_diagnostics
description: Get current VS Code language-service diagnostics for the active editor or a workspace-relative file.

name: editor_symbols
description: Get document symbols from the active editor or a workspace-relative file using registered VS Code language providers.

name: workspace_search
description: Search text in workspace source files with bounded results, skipping common dependency/build directories.

name: browser_open_url
description: Open an HTTP(S) URL in the user's configured browser. VS Code does not provide a universal stable API for inspecting arbitrary browser tabs.

name: ping
description: Returns simple success response, server version, and basic status.

name: workspace_info
description: Returns active workspace details and folder metadata via VS Code extension Agent.

name: list_workspace_files
description: Lists files and directories in the workspace via VS Code extension Agent.

dirPath.description: Workspace-relative directory path to list (defaults to root)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: read_file
description: Reads specified workspace file contents via VS Code extension Agent.

name: write_file
description: Proposes creating or overwriting a workspace file. In the VS Code extension, the change is not applied until the user accepts it in the VortiqLabs Agent sidebar; declining discards it.

content.description: Content to write to the file

name: edit_file
description: Proposes replacing a line range in a workspace file. In the VS Code extension, the change is not applied until the user accepts it in the VortiqLabs Agent sidebar; declining discards it.

content.description: Replacement content for specified line range

name: git_status
description: Returns current Git branch and working tree status via VS Code extension Agent.

name: git_diff
description: Returns working-tree git diff via VS Code extension Agent.

path.description: Optional workspace-relative file path to limit diff

name: git_apply_patch
description: Proposes a git patch for the workspace. In the VS Code extension, the patch is not applied until the user accepts it in the VortiqLabs Agent sidebar; declining discards it.

name: find_todos
description: Finds TODO, FIXME, HACK, and XXX markers in supported text files across the active VS Code workspace. Returns file paths and line numbers; scanning is bounded for safety.

maxResults.description: Maximum matching lines to return (default 100, maximum 500)

name: run_terminal
description: Execute a shell command from the active workspace root. Use this for commands such as tests, builds, linters, and Git inspection. Always provide a complete non-interactive command; do not use commands that require user input or leave a long-running process running. The command runs with a 30-second default timeout and a 120-second maximum timeout. A non-zero exit code is returned as a normal result so you can inspect stdout and stderr.

command.description: Complete non-interactive shell command to run from the workspace root

timeoutMs.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds; defaults to 30000 and is capped at 120000

name: file_diagnostics
description: Get every current VS Code error and warning for exactly one workspace file. Use this after editing or when validating a file. Provide a workspace-relative path, then inspect the returned severity, message, source/code, and 1-based range for each diagnostic. Informational and hint diagnostics are intentionally excluded.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to inspect, for example src/index.ts

name: indexer_status
description: Inspects Codebase Indexer status via VS Code extension Agent.

name: indexer_search
description: Searches codebase index via VS Code extension Agent.

query.description: Text or concept to search for in the indexed codebase

mode.description: Search strategy; hybrid is the default

name: indexer_symbols
description: Retrieves symbol information via VS Code extension Agent.

name: index_workspace
description: Indexes authorized workspace via VS Code extension Agent.

indexDir.description: Optional directory for storing index files

profile.description: Indexing profile for normal or large codebases

verboseMemory.description: Log memory usage during large index runs

name: indexer_install
description: Download and install the pinned Codebase Indexer runtime for this OS/architecture, verify its SHA-256, and reuse the cached installation on subsequent calls.

name: indexer_index_github
description: Download and index a GitHub repository using the Codebase Indexer runtime. Provide owner/repository or a GitHub URL; private repositories require GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN in the extension environment.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repository slug or repository URL

ref.description: Git branch, tag, or commit; defaults to HEAD

indexDir.description: Optional directory for storing the index

profile.description: Indexing profile for normal or large codebases

name: indexer_inspect
description: Read and validate metadata from a Codebase Indexer .index file. Use the index path returned by indexer_status or index_workspace.

path.description: Path to an existing Codebase Indexer .index file

name: indexer_remove
description: Delete the Codebase Indexer index for the specified workspace directory. This does not delete source files. Requires confirm=true; prefer the active workspace or a validated workspace-relative path.

path.description: Workspace-relative path for the indexed workspace; defaults to the active workspace

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm permanent deletion of this workspace's index

name: indexer_references
description: Find references to a symbol in the active workspace's Codebase Indexer index.

name: indexer_callers
description: Find functions or symbols that call the specified symbol.

name: indexer_callees
description: Find functions or symbols called by the specified symbol.

name: indexer_dependencies
description: Explore outgoing dependency relations for a symbol, with a bounded graph depth.

name: indexer_dependents
description: Find symbols that depend on or use the requested symbol, with a bounded graph depth.

name: indexer_symbol_path
description: Find a bounded dependency path between two symbol names in the indexed codebase.

name: indexer_files
description: List indexed files in the active workspace, optionally filtered by language or path substring.

language.description: Language identifier, e.g. TypeScript or Python

pattern.description: Substring to match in file paths

name: indexer_repository_map
description: Return a high-level map of repository areas, files, and indexed symbols.

name: indexer_api_endpoints
description: Discover API endpoint definitions detected in the indexed workspace.

name: indexer_classify_query
description: Classify a codebase question by likely query intent, helping choose the right search approach.

name: indexer_sensitive_regions
description: Scan the indexed workspace for likely sensitive regions such as credentials or tokens. The detector is heuristic; verify results and do not expose secrets in responses.

name: indexer_watch
description: Start an incremental Codebase Indexer watch process for the active workspace or a safe workspace-relative subdirectory. Use indexer_stop_watch when finished.

name: indexer_stop_watch
description: Stop the watch process started by this extension instance.

name: indexer_dashboard
description: Start the Codebase Indexer web dashboard on localhost. Use indexer_stop_dashboard when finished.

name: indexer_stop_dashboard
description: Stop the dashboard process started by this extension instance.
